name: Greece
contextBlurb: Greece regulates stablecoins under MiCA. EMT and ART issuance is permitted only with the required EU authorisation, reserve backing, redemption rights, white paper disclosures, governance and AML controls. Greek financial authorities implement the EU framework domestically.

legislation.title: Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA)
legislation.summary: EU-wide regulation covering stablecoin issuance, public offers and trading admission.

stablecoinMeta.summaryEn: Greece follows MiCA. Stablecoins are legal with restrictions for authorised EMT and ART issuers, including reserve, redemption, disclosure and AML obligations.

regulators.name: Hellenic Capital Market Commission
regulators.role: Greek market supervisor involved in MiCA implementation for crypto-asset services.
